name: Jorn Skyseer
summary: In the southern Barrens, seasoned Horde hunters seek guidance from Jorn Skyseer. After you hunt local raptors for Sergra Darkthorn, she sends you south to Camp Taurajo, where an elder tracker offers deeper lessons.

sections.title: Passing the Mantle
sections.body: You have hunted the cunning sunscale and scytheclaw raptors stalking the northern savannah, earning Sergra Darkthorn's respect at the Crossroads. She knows martial skill must be joined with understanding of the land's great beasts. With her mentorship complete, she sends you south.

sections.title: The Road to Taurajo
sections.body: Follow the Gold Road south through increasingly rugged plains to Camp Taurajo, a vital tauren settlement near the southern wilds. Jorn Skyseer waits there, an elder tracker ready to teach hunters how to pursue elusive, legendary quarry across the Barrens.

faq.q: Who sends me to Jorn Skyseer?
faq.answer: After you hunt the local scytheclaws, Sergra Darkthorn, the raptor hunter at the Crossroads, sends you south. Your hunts prove your tracking and hunting prowess.
Jorn Skyseer is at Camp Taurajo, far south along the main road through the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Jorn Skyseer?
faq.answer: When you report to him, Jorn welcomes you to the hunter's path and begins directing you to track and hunt elusive beasts across the southern Barrens. The first is the legendary raptor Ishamuhale.

faq.q: Do I need to be a hunter class to do this quest?
faq.answer: No. Any Horde adventurer who completes Sergra Darkthorn's raptor hunts can follow this path of learning how to track the plains, whatever their class.

faq.q: Why does Sergra stop teaching you herself?
aliases: why does sergra send you away
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn works among the northern raptor nests near the Crossroads. Once you master those hunts, she sends you south to Jorn Skyseer, who oversees deeper expeditions into southern game.

Camp Taurajo is a tauren encampment in the southern Barrens. It is a hunting post, trading hub, and cultural waystation for travelers journeying between the northern plains and Mulgore or Thousand Needles.

angles.text: As a hunter, you meet Jorn Skyseer, who tests your ability to outsmart and conquer the legendary apex predators of the central and southern plains.
As a tauren returning south toward Camp Taurajo, you reconnect tribal huntsmanship with the spiritual guardianship of the Barrens' wilderness.
As a member of the Horde, you travel from the Crossroads to Camp Taurajo, deeper into the contested southern Barrens.
